scope.statement: For a six-vertex, two-face unit-rhombus train with a fixed seventh contact isolate, the full-source common-shear family is feasible exactly for |cos(theta)| <= 21/100; interior shears preserve (|C|,|H|)=(7,2), the boundary adds a diameter pair, and further shear violates an upper pair.
scope.domain: Seven explicit labels v_(i,j)=i(1,0)+j(c,s), i=0,1,2 and j=0,1, plus z=(1,11/5), with c in [-1,1], s=sqrt(1-c^2)>=0, and every unordered pair checked.
scope.limitations: Exact finite regression only. This source is not claimed to be globally minimizing or canonical. No other motion, source extraction, replacement, asymptotic consequence, or theorem promotion is established.

result: Verified exact 21-pair ledger and sharp shear cap for the stated finite family; no strict-D or lexicographic improvement occurs in this family.
remaining_questions: Can a canonical full-core C-II face-coupled motion transport its diameter-setting contact isolates with the train while preserving every old lower and actual or inactive upper pair constraint?
